title: Unit Event — At The End of The Unraveled Thread — Episode4 What Happened That Time

meta.Event: At The End of The Unraveled Thread
meta.Event Outline: MORE MORE JUMP! is all set for their first TV appearance. However, the show's MC just happens to be the leader of the very group Shizuku used to be in, Cheerful * Days. As excited as she was about making their shoot a success, this surprise reunion has Shizuku...

rows.Line: A few days later
Stage SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: So, you've already had your meeting...?!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Then, all that's left is the actual shoot... This is so exciting!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I know it's not going to be easy, so we'll understand if you feel a little nervous. However, we're very much looking forward to seeing your beautiful smiles on TV!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Thanks!
We're gonna prep as much as we can leading up to it!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Which means...
We have to start brainstorming what could come our way.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Right. They may've provided us with a script, but the producer did mention how surprises are always welcome.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: We don't know what the Cheerful * Days MCs are going to throw at us, so we need to be prepared to answer some unexpected questions.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Speaking of which...
You met with Cheerful * Days at the TV station, yes?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
What were they like...?
It was your first time seeing them after you left, right, Shizuku?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Yes.
I was a little nervous at first, but I managed.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: We greeted each other like normal and agreed to do everything we can for our shoot...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: If I'm gonna be honest, that left a pretty bad taste in my mouth...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I mean, they said some really awful things about you, Shizuku. The least they could do is apologize.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Airi...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Still, it seemed like it was more or less all water under the bridge, which is good...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Also, about Higure... She became the lead after you left, right, Shizuku?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, Arisa...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: She has a very strong sense of responsibility and has this talent for pulling everybody in the right direction. Which is why when I saw that she had become the new lead, I thought she was the perfect person for the job.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Is something wrong?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Is something wrong...?
I'm flabbergasted by how you can praise her after she said all those atrocious things about you.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But I guess that's just who you are... I'd never be able to do that.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I'm saying this because she really is a hard-working person.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Also, I don't think they were wrong about what they said about me back then...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Member A
rows.Line: Shizuku got another solo photo shoot for a magazine cover. This is clearly favoritism.

rows.Speaker: Member B
rows.Line: Yeah, I guess a pretty face is all they care about. We're clearly better at singing and dancing than she is.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: It always took me more time than the others to master new songs and dances...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Not only that, but I always needed their help whenever we appeared on TV or did shows and such. I have a hard time saying that I was suited to be the lead.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Shizuku...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, I'm sorry...
I didn't mean for you to all feel so worried.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
No, it's just...
That must've been such an ordeal...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
It was nothing, really...
I don't think it was me who had it tough, but rather...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Actually, why don't I take this opportunity to tell you more about what happened between me and Cheerful * Days?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
B-But... Are you sure...?
Doesn't that mean you have to reopen some old wounds...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: It's okay...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: If anything, I want you all to know. I believe this will help clear the air and allow us to properly prepare for our shoot.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Shizuku...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Alright...
If you're okay with this, we're listening.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Thank you...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I'm sure you already know this, but I joined Cheerful * Days after auditioning for them...
A few years ago
Talent Agency

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: When I first joined this agency, I was billed more often as the “Grand Prix winner” as opposed to the new member of Cheerful * Days.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
I remember being so busy too.
I was constantly asked to do interviews on TV and short segments for certain shows...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: So, I wasn't able to meet the other girls who joined at the same time as me until much later... But it was a very memorable moment for me.

rows.Speaker: Producer
rows.Line: This is the most recent Grand Prix winner. Shizuku Hinomori.

rows.Speaker: Producer
rows.Line: She's a member of the third generation just like all of you and will be joining you on stage moving forward. I hope you'll give her a warm welcome.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: H-Hello. My name is Shizuku Hinomori... I apologize for not introducing myself sooner.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I, um... Unlike the rest of you, I don't have any experience in the entertainment industry... But I'm hoping to learn what I can as we go along...!

rows.Speaker: Group Members
rows.Line: Nice to meet you, Shizuku!

rows.Speaker: Group Members
rows.Line: This is a little odd since we're members of the same generation, but I've been following you on TV. I actually saw you earlier today! Let's do our best together!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Yes, of course...!
Thank you very much!

rows.Speaker: Arisa
rows.Line:
Hehe.
We're the same generation and the same age, so there's no need to be so formal.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Oh, that girl...)

rows.Speaker: Arisa
rows.Line: You're wondering if we've met before, yes...? I was the runner-up in the Grand Prix just behind you.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, I remember. You're Arisa Higure, yes? You're so cute, and such a good singer and dancer... You definitely left a big impression on me.

rows.Speaker: Arisa
rows.Line:
Really?
But that's coming from the girl with the most brilliant aura of all time.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh...
I'm sorry. I didn't mean to...

rows.Speaker: Arisa
rows.Line: Haha. Sorry, I was just pulling your leg!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Huh? Um...

rows.Speaker: Arisa
rows.Line: Again, there's no need to act so formal here. After all, we're members of the same group. Also...

rows.Speaker: Arisa
rows.Line: I lost the audition, but I'm going to become a select member no matter what. So, I want you to also give it everything you have.

rows.Speaker: Arisa
rows.Line: Let's do our best to make it so everyone calls the third generation the best ever in the history of Cheerful * Days, Shizuku!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, let's...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
That was the first time I met everyone...
Arisa in particular was a powerful figure that I believe would be leading others someday.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: From there on, I began learning more about the entertainment industry while receiving a long list of offers.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Everyone was very nice...
We always had so much fun while waiting backstage or in the green room.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Then, one day... We were told that we'd be releasing a new song. Something different and not in our usual genre...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: The dance for it was much more dynamic than usual, which I struggled just to memorize... But the others also had a hard time.
Practice Space

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Huff... Huff...

rows.Speaker: Group Members
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
I'm exhausted!
The dance for this song's way too hard!

rows.Speaker: Group Members
rows.Line: Honestly, I'm struggling to just keep up. I don't even have the time to see what everyone else is doing... And this is the opening number for our show? How are we going to get through it?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (I knew this song wasn't going to be easy to learn, but the others are also struggling... And they're by far way better dancers than I am...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Am I actually keeping up with them...?)

rows.Speaker: Arisa
rows.Line:
Hey, whining won't get us anywhere.
We have to get this completely down before our show.

rows.Speaker: Group Members
rows.Line:
*Sob*
We know that, but...

rows.Speaker: Arisa
rows.Line:
Alright, cheer up.
I mean, don't forget that we've overcome a lot as a group already.

rows.Speaker: Arisa
rows.Line: So, why don't we all go out for some barbeque today? We've been practicing nonstop for a while now, so I think we deserve a little break.

rows.Speaker: Group Members
rows.Line:
B-Barbeque?!
Yeah! Let's go!

rows.Speaker: Arisa
rows.Line:
Alright, let's go!
How about you, Shizuku...?!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, I...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
I'd like to go, but...
I really need to practice this routine a little more.

rows.Speaker: Group Members
rows.Line:
Wait, you're still gonna practice?
But it's already getting pretty late.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
I know...
But I'm not as good at dancing as the rest of you, so I need to practice more to keep up...

rows.Speaker: Arisa
rows.Line:
Then, I'll join you!
I can't go knowing that you're going to be practicing!

rows.Speaker: Group Members
rows.Line: Wait, Arisa, what about barbeque?!

rows.Speaker: Group Members
rows.Line:
We practiced so much today!
And I've got a huge craving for barbeque now!

rows.Speaker: Arisa
rows.Line: Yes, but...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Don't mind me. Please go ahead.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I'd rather not keep you behind since you've already mastered it, Arisa.

rows.Speaker: Arisa
rows.Line:
No, I really haven't...
Some parts still definitely need work...

rows.Speaker: Group Members
rows.Line:
But breaks are important too, right?
Shizuku's giving us the green light, so let's go stuff our faces!

rows.Speaker: Arisa
rows.Line: Alright, fine. Let's go...

rows.Speaker: Arisa
rows.Line: Please don't push yourself too hard, Shizuku. We really don't want you to get injured in the process.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Thank you. I promise to be careful, so please go have fun.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
As unfortunate as it is that I can't join them, I need to keep practicing.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Since learning the dance routine as a whole has taken up so much of my time, I'm still struggling to master the details.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
(I can somewhat do the dance...
But at this rate, I won't look very good on stage.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: So...
se_event_thread_2023_004

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Let's keep trying!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I'll start again from the top and do what the dance teacher said. Move with grace and elegance...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: And I'm not moving my hips very well for this part. I need to flow with the rhythm...

rows.Speaker: Staff
rows.Line:
Huh?
Sir, what are you doing here?

rows.Speaker: Producer
rows.Line:
Hmm...
You've been watching these girls for quite a while now. Tell me. What do you think of Hinomori?

rows.Speaker: Staff
rows.Line: What do I think...? She has this incredible aura. I mean, she outshined all the others during their first show.

rows.Speaker: Staff
rows.Line: And I love how she has this incredible work ethic. Also, she can also be a little clumsy sometimes, so I think that contrast makes her more appealing...

rows.Speaker: Staff
rows.Line: In that sense, she may end up garnering the support of the more hardcore fans as opposed to the casual ones.

rows.Speaker: Producer
rows.Line: Which is a problem...

rows.Speaker: Producer
rows.Line: Hinomori won the Grand Prix because so many people were compelled by her perfect looks. To them, she's a beautiful but delicate flower that can accomplish anything flawlessly...

rows.Speaker: Producer
rows.Line: As a result, she's received more media exposure than anyone else from the third generation. So, we can't afford to disappoint everyone.

rows.Speaker: Staff
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Producer
rows.Line: That's why we need to find a new way to bill her. If we don't, her fifteen minutes as the Grand Prix winner will be over before we know it.

rows.Speaker: Producer
rows.Line: Nobody wants to see Hinomori the clumsy girl...
